mapper.sql: select qd.detail_id, i.inquiry_no, s.supplier_code, q.supplier_name, qd.material_code, qd.material_name, qd.specification, qd.unit, qd.quantity, qd.price, q.create_time as quotation_date, q.valid_date, qd.tax_rate, q.delivery_days, q.payment_terms, case when q.supplier_id = i.award_supplier_id and i.award_supplier_id is not null then '1' else '0' end as is_award from pms_quotation_detail qd left join pms_quotation q on qd.quotation_id = q.quotation_id left join pms_inquiry i on q.inquiry_id = i.inquiry_id left join wms_supplier s on q.supplier_id = s.supplier_id where qd.del_flag = '0' and q.del_flag = '0' and i.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select:
AND q.supplier_name like concat('%', #{supplierName}, '%')
AND s.supplier_code like concat('%', #{supplierCode}, '%')
AND qd.material_name like concat('%', #{materialName}, '%')
AND qd.material_code like concat('%', #{materialCode}, '%')
AND i.inquiry_no like concat('%', #{inquiryNo}, '%')
AND i.award_supplier_id IS NOT NULL AND q.supplier_id = i.award_supplier_id
AND (i.award_supplier_id IS NULL OR q.supplier_id != i.award_supplier_id)
order by qd.material_code, qd.price asc, q.create_time desc
